subject: [Northwind demo] Decision: Typesense for in-app search
body:
To: Alice <alice@northwind.example>

Alice,

We are going with Typesense over Algolia for in-app search. It is about 70% cheaper at our volume, we can self-host it next to Postgres, and typo tolerance was equal in our tests.

I own rollout on October 28 behind the search_v2 flag. The open question is index sharding past 5 million documents. The full record is in Notion, "Search decision record" (Northwind Labs: Search decision record).

Dave
